goal: Prove the commercial argument and the acceptance checks on a small vertical film before a full build
audience: People who like a known fragrance and shop on a phone
message: Start from a scent you already love and find its equivalent
concept: One action carries the film: name a scent you love, see its matching notes, take the same action at the end

strategy.audience: People who already love a known fragrance and shop on a phone
strategy.action: Search the shop for the equivalent of a scent they know
strategy.benefit: Start from a known scent instead of browsing a catalogue
strategy.friction: Buying a scent blind online; not knowing where to start
evidence: Note list of the matched product
Product photograph with a white background (proposed)
strategy.mechanism: Search to match: the question names the scent, the notes answer it, the CTA repeats the search

cta.closes: search for the equivalent of a known scent

alternatives.concept: Search to match (known scent, notes, same action as CTA)
alternatives.reason: Shows the store's reason to exist with one action the viewer can repeat

alternatives.concept: Category tour (for her, for him, unisex)
alternatives.reason: Summarises a catalogue; any store could say it

alternatives.concept: Price comparison with a well-known original
alternatives.reason: Needs verified prices, sizes and equivalence; Unknown here

runtime.value: Studio Python renderer (render.py) for the proof

confirmed: 1080 x 1920, 30 FPS, 600 frames (20 s, the scope of the reviewed vertical reel)

acceptance: Every visible word is complete in every readable hold (text audit)
The hook question is answered by the notes scene, and the end card repeats the search action
Nothing in the copy states a price, saving or equivalence that is not verified

scenes.argues: names the viewer's situation: a scent they already love
scenes.purpose: Hook with a question the film answers

scenes.argues: shows the action: search, compare, choose
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate how the match is found
scenes.entry: Steps arrive one by one with a connector
scenes.transition: The last step hands over to its result

scenes.argues: answers the hook with the matched notes
scenes.purpose: Payoff: the notes of the match

scenes.argues: asks for the same action the film showed
